text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features. The previous suggestion of migraine is inconsistent with the severity and nature of your psychotic symptoms. I have requested a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel and EEG to rule out any organic causes, but your clinical presentation strongly points to a primary psychiatric disorder. We will proceed with initiating an antidepressant regimen and potentially an antipsychotic to manage the hallucinations and depressive symptoms.
